column1: # Genome manifest for the whole-pipeline TE-annotation benchmark.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   species_key    short slug (no spaces); drives all output paths
#   display_name   human-readable label for plots (spaces OK)
#   accession      NCBI RefSeq/GenBank assembly accession (downloaded by 01)
#   scoring        gold  -> lib-test.py against a curated library
#                  proxy -> coverage% + pairwise Jaccard concordance + LAI
# NB rows are addressed BY POSITION by submit_benchmark.slurm (--array index =
# row order here, comments/blanks skipped). APPEND new genomes at the end;
# inserting in the middle silently re-points every array index after it.
